name: primal_infeasible_minor
description: 2x2 SDP pinning X_11=1, X_22=1, X_12=2 (the off-diagonal constraint <A_3,X> = 2*X_12 = 4 fixes X_12=2). Infeasible because the 2x2 PSD principal-minor inequality X_11*X_22 >= X_12^2 reduces to 1 >= 4, which is false. A well-conditioned primal-infeasible problem (no singular Schur / tau NaN): tau -> 6e-11, kappa -> 25 at prec=128.
witness: Farkas y = (-1,-1,1): sum_i y_i A_i = [[-1,1],[1,-1]] (eigs 0,-2) <= 0, and b^T y = (1)(-1)+(1)(-1)+(4)(1) = 2 > 0. Verified numerically (eigvalsh, det = 0). Hence no X >= 0 satisfies all three constraints (Farkas alternative).
